title: Prescription Insurance on File — Terms on the Number of Plans Held on One Profile
content:
**1. Limit.** Under **Prescription Insurance on File**, a patient may have at most **2** coverage records open at the same time. A coverage record is open while its status is pending verification or active.

**2. Billing order of open records.** Of the two open records, one carries the billing order primary and the other the billing order secondary. Two open records never share the same billing order.

**3. History.** Terminated and removed coverage records stay on the patient's profile as history and do not count toward the limit.

**4. A third plan.** A third plan is added only after one of the two open records is removed or terminated.

## The same terms as a table

| Open records on the profile (pending verification or active) | May another plan be added? |
|---|---|
| None | Yes |
| One | Yes, with the billing order the open record does not hold |
| Two | No — only after one of the two is removed or terminated |

Terminated and removed records are left out of the count in every row.

## Illustrations (hypothetical profiles)

- A profile shows one active record billed as primary and one terminated record. Only one record is open, so a new plan may be added; because the open record already holds primary, the two open records may not both be primary.
- A profile shows one active primary record and one secondary record still pending verification. Two records are open; a third plan is added only once one of them is removed or terminated.
- A profile shows three removed records and nothing else. No record is open, and the removed records remain visible as history.
